note: ⛔ SNG-462. Two Mind social abilities closing the `provoke` and `soothe` zeros. See SYSTEM_SPEC §31.5.

abilities.name: Force the Move
abilities.narrationHints: A short, specific, true observation. Not an insult — insults are easy to ignore. The archer comes down off the wall to say something back, and is now an archer standing in a courtyard.
abilities.description: Say the one thing that makes waiting impossible — and an enemy who was holding a good position gives it up to answer you.
abilities.notFor: Anyone with no stake in what you say; making them do a SPECIFIC thing; anything already in motion.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOU GET ACTION, NOT OBEDIENCE — they move, and what they do is theirs
it must be TRUE, or true enough that they fear it is
⚠️ they remember who said it, and people do not forgive this
one person, in earshot, who cares what is said about them

abilities.plainly: A social/duel action that forces an enemy to act early. Its strength is rated 6 out of 10.

tree.name: Make Them Answer
tree.grants: ⛔ AN ENEMY WHO IS HOLDING ADVANTAGE GIVES IT UP TO RESPOND. The archer leaves the wall. The captain answers instead of ordering. The one waiting in ambush speaks. ⚠️ MECHANICALLY: they lose their held action, their cover or their prepared position for a round, and act on YOUR timing.
tree.cannot: You choose WHEN they act, never WHAT. What they do is still theirs, and a good fighter provoked is still a good fighter.

tree.name: Break the Line
tree.grants: ⛔ SAY IT TO A GROUP AND SEVERAL ANSWER AT ONCE, giving up held positions to respond — a shield line opens, a patrol turns to look, a council all speak over each other. Formations, ambushes and coordinated actions break for a round.
tree.cannot: The bigger the group, the shallower it lands on any one of them. Disciplined troops re-form fast.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS TARGETS AND FORMATION. Say it to a group and several answer at once — a shield line opens, a patrol turns to look, a council all speak over each other. ⛔ Formations, ambushes and coordinated actions break for a round.

tree.name: On the Record
tree.grants: ⛔ FORCE A COMMITMENT THEY CANNOT WALK BACK — an order given in front of the people who must carry it out, an accusation with witnesses, a challenge accepted. They will honour it, and you can plan around it.
tree.cannot: They must have standing to lose. Someone with no reputation cannot be trapped by one.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS PERMANENCE. Force a commitment they cannot walk back — an order given in front of the people who must carry it out, an accusation with witnesses, a challenge accepted. ⚠️ They will regret it and they will honour it, and you can plan around it.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-462, REWRITTEN. Erik: 'good that it gets action — that's the point of provoke — but limiting it to what they are MOST AFRAID OF? OMG SPIDERS... what?? Make this less flavour and MORE SPECIFIC. How would a player BENEFIT from using this?'
⚠️ THE OLD TEXT PUT FLAVOUR WHERE THE MECHANIC GOES. ⛔ THE BENEFIT IS TEMPO: you use it when the ENEMY HAS THE ADVANTAGE OF PATIENCE — the archer on the wall, the ambush that is waiting, the captain who has not committed. It converts their good position into a bad one because they had to answer you.
abilities._diceStrip:
⛔ SNG-471, CCODE Q1: `mechanic.dice` IS consumed — craftmechanics.mechanicFor → rollMagnitude → skill_battle.js:798 — ⚠️ BUT THE GUARD IS `shape === 'damage'`, and only `damage` and `strike` resolve to it. `hobble` and `hinder` DO NOT.
⛔ SO THIS CRAFT AUTHORED 2d6 THAT NOTHING WOULD EVER ROLL. Erik's shape is right — a hold is not damage — so the DICE GO, not the shape. ⚠️ CCode: 'I would not widen the guard silently — "this craft does 4d6 of hold" is a different claim about the world.' AGREED.

abilities.name: Quiet the Room
abilities.narrationHints: Nobody is told to calm down. The shouting runs out of somewhere to go, and afterwards nobody can say who stopped it.
abilities.description: End fear, rage or panic as a condition — stop a rout, talk a mob down, or bring an ally back who has been provoked, frightened or broken.
abilities.notFor: Making anyone agree with you; a fear that is correct; anything already in motion — a swung blade lands.

bounds.text: ⛔ IT REMOVES HEAT, NOT REASONS. They still want what they wanted, calmly
nothing already in motion stops — a swung blade lands
⚠️ it works on YOU too, and a person who needed their fear may resent that
a second use on the same people the same day does much less

abilities.plainly: A social/survive action that ends fear, rage or panic. Its strength is rated 5 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 stops a rout, rank 3 restores someone already broken.

tree.name: End the Condition
tree.grants: ⛔ REMOVE FEAR, RAGE OR PANIC FROM ONE PERSON OR A SMALL GROUP. ⚠️ MECHANICALLY: it ends a fear or provoke effect on an ally, stops a fleeing NPC fleeing, or makes a frightened witness able to speak. ⛔ IT IS THE COUNTER TO PROVOKE, and to every craft that works by terror.
tree.cannot: They still want what they wanted — it removes the heat, not the reason. Nothing already swung stops.

tree.name: Stop the Rout
tree.grants: ⛔ END FEAR, RAGE OR PANIC ACROSS A WHOLE GROUP. A unit stops routing and re-forms; a mob turning ugly does not turn; a ward full of wounded stops screaming and can be worked in. In a fight this rallies allies who have broken.
tree.cannot: The larger the group, the shallower it goes. A determined agitator can bring it back up next round.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⚠️ ADDS SCALE AND COMBAT USE. A whole unit stops routing and re-forms; a mob turning ugly does not turn; a ward full of wounded stops screaming and can be worked in. ⛔ In a fight this rallies allies who have broken.

tree.name: Back From It
tree.grants: ⛔ BRING ONE PERSON BACK FROM WHERE FEAR OR GRIEF HAS ALREADY TAKEN THEM — the broken soldier who has stopped fighting for good, the witness who has not spoken in weeks, the one who has decided to die.
tree.cannot: One person, and it takes a quiet hour. It gives them back the ability to choose; it does not choose for them.
tree._grantsWas_SNG510: ⛔ ADDS RECOVERY OF THE LONG-TERM. Bring one person back from where fear or grief has ALREADY taken them — the broken soldier who has stopped fighting for good, the witness who has not spoken in weeks, the one who has decided to die. ⚠️ This is not a combat rank; it restores an NPC or a companion to usefulness.

abilities._authored:
⛔ SNG-462, REWRITTEN. Erik: 'ok, but what does REMOVING HEAT DO??? functionally in game. When would a player use this, and is it so rare as to not be worth the skill slot?'
⚠️ FAIR — 'takes the heat out' is a mood, not an effect. ⛔ IT ENDS A CONDITION: fear, rage, panic, and any provoke effect. THAT IS ITS FREQUENCY ANSWER TOO — it is the direct counter to Force the Move and to every terror-based craft, plus rallying a rout, which is common in any fight that goes badly.
abilities._wardTypes:
⛔ SNG-512. ⛔ Ends fear, rage and panic. Answers feeling and nothing else, which is the whole craft.
⚠️ `wardTypes` WAS ZERO ACROSS THE CORPUS — 26 crafts carried a `damageType` and nothing answered any of them. `answers(l)` already matches a layer to a kind; this is the missing half.

_gainAxes: ⛔ SNG-468: `gainAxes` derived per rank from the rank's own text. ⚠️ MY MATRIX HAD BEEN READING UNPOPULATED RANKS AS 'ADDS NOTHING' — Erik caught it on Borrowed Form, whose ranks are an hour / a day plus a passenger / the whole party. THE SKILL WAS FINE; THE INSTRUMENT WAS BROKEN.
_sng510: ⛔ SNG-510: grants rewritten SELF-CONTAINED. CCode measured that `progression.abilitiesForGM` sends ONLY the rank the player holds — `tree.find(t => t.rank === owned.level)` — so a grant opening 'ADDS RANGE. Throw it' referred to an r1 the model never sees. ⚠️ STRIPPING THE OPENER WAS NOT ENOUGH: 'it' and 'the same force' had no antecedent either. Each rank now names its own craft, its own effect and its own numbers.
